The document is the suggestion of the common interface signal (for reference when building the Wishbone).

# Wishbone Master and Slave Implementation

**Source References:**
- https://wishbone-interconnect.readthedocs.io/en/latest/01_introduction.html

## 1. Summary

* **Master Interface:** is an IP core interface capable of initiating data transfer cycles. Every WISHBONE-based system must include at least one MASTER interface.
* **Slave Interface:** is an IP core interface capable of receiving and responding to transfer cycles generated by a MASTER. Every WISHBONE-based system must include at least one SLAVE interface.

## 2. Signal Description

This section details the signals utilized within the WISHBONE interconnect architecture. Depending on the specific interface implementation, certain signals are optional and may be omitted.

## 3. SYSCON Module Signals

| Signal Name | Label | I/O | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CLK_O` | System Clock Output | Output | Generated by SYSCON; routed by INTERCON to `CLK_I` on all interfaces to coordinate logic. |
| `RST_O` | Reset Output | Output | Generated by SYSCON; routed by INTERCON to `RST_I` on all interfaces to restart state machines. |

## 4. Signals Common to MASTER and SLAVE Interfaces

| Signal Name | Label | I/O | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CLK_I` | Clock Input | Input | Primary clock. Outputs are registered on rising edge; inputs must be stable prior to it. |
| `DAT_I()` | Data Input Array | Input | Receives binary data (max 64 bits). Paired with `DAT_O()` and `SEL_O()`/`SEL_I()`. |
| `DAT_O()` | Data Output Array | Output | Drives binary data (max 64 bits). Paired with `DAT_I()` and `SEL_O()`/`SEL_I()`. |
| `RST_I` | Reset Input | Input | Resets interface state machines to initial states. Does not require resetting core logic. |
| `TGD_I()` | Data Tag Input | Input | Metadata bus for `DAT_I()`, qualified by `STB_I` (e.g., parity, ECC, timestamps). |
| `TGD_O()` | Data Tag Output | Output | Metadata bus for `DAT_O()`, qualified by `STB_O` (e.g., parity, ECC, timestamps). |

## 5. MASTER Interface Signals

| Signal Name | Label | I/O | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ACK_I` | Acknowledge Input | Input | Asserted by SLAVE to indicate normal cycle completion. |
| `ADR_O()` | Address Output Array | Output | Target binary address output. Bounds depend on core width, port size, and granularity. |
| `CYC_O` | Cycle Output | Output | High for the entire transaction cycle. Used by arbiters for bus allocation. |
| `ERR_I` | Error Input | Input | Asserted by SLAVE to indicate abnormal cycle termination. |
| `LOCK_O` | Lock Output | Output | Requests uninterruptible bus ownership until `LOCK_O` or `CYC_O` is negated. |
| `RTY_I` | Retry Input | Input | Asserted by SLAVE when busy, requesting a cycle retry. |
| `SEL_O()` | Select Output Array | Output | Indicates active byte lanes for READ (`DAT_I`) and WRITE (`DAT_O`). |
| `STB_O` | Strobe Output | Output | Qualifies valid transfers. Requires a SLAVE response (`ACK_I`, `ERR_I`, or `RTY_I`). |
| `TGA_O()` | Address Tag Output | Output | Metadata for `ADR_O()`, qualified by `STB_O` (e.g., address size, protection flags). |
| `TGC_O()` | Cycle Tag Output | Output | Metadata qualified by `CYC_O` (e.g., cycle type, SINGLE/BLOCK/RMW mode). |
| `WE_O` | Write Enable Output | Output | Transfer direction: `1` for WRITE, `0` for READ. |

## 6. SLAVE Interface Signals

| Signal Name | Label | I/O | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ACK_O` | Acknowledge Output | Output | Asserted to indicate normal cycle termination. |
| `ADR_I()` | Address Input Array | Input | Target binary address received from MASTER. |
| `CYC_I` | Cycle Input | Input | High while a valid bus cycle is in progress across all transfers. |
| `ERR_O` | Error Output | Output | Asserted to indicate abnormal transfer termination. |
| `LOCK_I` | Lock Input | Input | Indicates uninterruptible transfer; locks access to requesting MASTER. |
| `RTY_O` | Retry Output | Output | Asserted to instruct MASTER to retry the cycle. |
| `SEL_I()` | Select Input Array | Input | Indicates active byte lanes for WRITE (`DAT_I`) and READ (`DAT_O`). |
| `STB_I` | Strobe Input | Input | Indicates SLAVE selection. Must respond to every strobe with `ACK_O`, `ERR_O`, or `RTY_O`. |
| `TGA_I()` | Address Tag Input | Input | Metadata for `ADR_I()`, qualified by `STB_I` (e.g., address size, protection flags). |
| `TGC_I()` | Cycle Tag Input | Input | Metadata qualified by `CYC_I` (e.g., cycle type, SINGLE/BLOCK/RMW mode). |
| `WE_I` | Write Enable Input | Input | Transfer direction: `1` for WRITE, `0` for READ. |
